events.label: founding
events.text: Decision made to set up a permanent fighter air wing.

evidence.quote: In 1936 , the decision was made to set up a permanent fighter air wing

events.text: New construction for the wing began.

evidence.quote: New construction for the wing took place from 1937 to 1944

events.text: Georg Gärdin became commanding officer.

evidence.quote: 1938–1941 : Georg Gärdin

events.text: Three squadrons of J 8 moved from F 1 to Barkarby.

evidence.quote: moved to Barkarby on October 1 , 1938

events.label: colour_presented
events.text: Colour presented to the wing by King Gustaf V.

evidence.quote: A colour was presented to the wing on 6 June 1939

events.text: Squadrons re-equipped with J 9 aircraft.

evidence.quote: were rather quickly replaced in 1940 by J 9

events.text: Georg Gärdin's term as commanding officer ended.

evidence.quote: 1938–1941 : Georg Gärdin

events.text: Lars Hägglöf became commanding officer.

evidence.quote: 1941–1952 : Lars Hägglöf

events.text: New construction for the wing ended.

evidence.quote: New construction for the wing took place from 1937 to 1944

events.text: Squadrons re-equipped with J 22 after the war.

evidence.quote: In 1945 after the end of the war , the squadrons were reequipped with J 22

events.text: Squadrons gradually converted to jets with J 28B Vampire.

evidence.quote: In 1949 the squadrons were gradually converted to jets with the introduction of J 28B Vampire

events.text: Squadrons replaced J 28B Vampire with J 29 Tunnan.

evidence.quote: They were in turn replaced in 1952 with J 29 Tunnan

events.text: Lars Hägglöf's term as commanding officer ended.

evidence.quote: 1941–1952 : Lars Hägglöf

events.text: Sven Uggla became commanding officer.

evidence.quote: 1952–1963 : Sven Uggla

events.text: Squadrons received J 34 Hunter aircraft.

evidence.quote: In 1957 the squadrons received the J 34 Hunter

events.text: Decision to base Rb 68 Bloodhound missile at F 8.

evidence.quote: In 1961 a decision was made to base the new high-altitude Rb 68 Bloodhound surface-to-air missile at F 8

events.text: Nils-Fredrik Palmstierna became commanding officer.

evidence.quote: 1963–1967 : Nils-Fredrik Palmstierna

events.text: Sven Uggla's term as commanding officer ended.

evidence.quote: 1952–1963 : Sven Uggla

events.text: Three squadrons disbanded; aircraft transferred to other wings.

evidence.quote: kept until 1964 when the three squadrons were disbanded

events.text: Nils-Fredrik Palmstierna's term as commanding officer ended.

evidence.quote: 1963–1967 : Nils-Fredrik Palmstierna

evidence.quote: 1967–1974 : Stig Bruse

events.label: decommissioning
events.text: Active military base decommissioned.

evidence.quote: F 8 remained an active military base until the decommissioning in 1974

events.text: Base opened for general aviation use.

evidence.quote: decommissioning in 1974 when it was opened for general aviation

events.text: Stig Bruse's term as commanding officer ended.

evidence.quote: for around 1990 being submitted to the Swedish Army Museum

events.label: colour_preserved

events.label: closure
events.text: Airfield closed down permanently.

evidence.quote: In 2010 the airfield was closed down permanently
